title: Abstracto
tagline: Abstracto simplifies the user onboarding process for decentralized applications (dApps) by offering trial versions without the need for signups, wallet creation, or private key management.
description:
Abstracto is here to make the world of decentralized applications (dApps) accessible for everyone. With thousands of dApps available, it's crucial to simplify the onboarding process. Our user-friendly solution offers trial versions of dApps and enables developers to easily plug our utility into their existing dApps for a seamless experience. We've achieved this by utilizing Solidity, existing smart contracts for Gnosis Safe, and the proposed EIP-4337, which together enable account abstraction on Ethereum.

In our visual examples, we demonstrated the process using ApeCoin. By leveraging account abstraction, we ensure smooth interactions with dApps while maintaining security and decentralization. With Abstracto, explore a diverse range of dApps in a welcoming and inclusive environment, and together, let's build a thriving decentralized ecosystem for all.
